definitions.explanation: A physical column or post that supports a structure, plant, or object.
A person, thing, or concept that serves as the main support for a group, organization, or system.

examples.japanese: ⟦トマト→トマト：05192_tomato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{支柱|しちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: Set up a support stake for the tomato plant.

examples.japanese: {支柱|しちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{折|お}れて→折れる：01266_oreru⟧、⟦テント→テント：03859_tento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: The support pole broke and the tent collapsed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強風|きょうふう}→強風：15269_kyoufuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えられる→耐える：12087_taeru⟧よう、⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支柱|しちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{補強|ほきょう}→補強：14024_hokyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We reinforced it with metal supports to withstand strong winds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支柱|しちゅう}だ。
examples.english: He is the pillar of the team.

examples.japanese: ⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支柱|しちゅう}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Agriculture is the mainstay of the local economy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支柱|しちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}い→失う：01887_ushinau⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{途方|とほう}に{暮|く}れた→途方に暮れる：17548_tohounikureru⟧。
examples.english: Having lost the pillar of her family, she was at a complete loss.

notes:
A compound of {支|し} (to support) and {柱|ちゅう} (pillar). Used both for literal structural supports and figuratively for people or things that hold something up.

USAGE:
In the physical sense, commonly used for garden stakes, tent poles, and structural supports. In the figurative sense, describes indispensable people or elements — the "backbone" of a family, organization, or economy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {支柱|しちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ — to set up a support/stake
- {支柱|しちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧ — to lose one's pillar/mainstay
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支柱|しちゅう} — economic mainstay
- ⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧{支柱|しちゅう} — emotional/spiritual pillar

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧ — pillar, column; more general, both literal and figurative
- ⟦{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}→大黒柱：18511_daikokubashira⟧ — main pillar; the primary breadwinner or central support
- ⟦{土台|どだい}→土台：07146_dodai⟧ — foundation; the base that supports a structure
